components.name: App Bar
components.description: One flat white pill with the brand and the places; the selected place is a fill, never a shadow of its own. Top on desktop, floating at the bottom on a phone. The pill is the one control-like element that casts a shadow.

narrative.overview: A warm paper desk with white sheets on it. Everything you read, enter or edit lies on a sheet; the desk itself stays empty and calm. Kan-Do is a working tool that is glanced at many times a day, so the columns, the cards and the one running task stand clearly apart, and nothing asks for attention it has not earned.
keyCharacteristics: A warm neutral canvas, never a saturated one; colour comes in small doses.
White sheets lifted by one warm shadow, one level only: never a sheet on a sheet.
One muted forest green for action and for done; orange for attention, red for what is destructive or failed.
A serif (Fraunces) for headings, the sans (Figtree) for everything read and operated.
Questions are asked in place; reversible actions act at once and offer undo.
Motion is small and physical and explains a state change.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: One solid green button per view. Marks, selected options, links and the focus ring are green without being a fill.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Green means action or done, orange attention, red destructive or failed. None of them appears for emphasis, branding or variety; integration brand colours do not appear at all.

rules.name: The Topic Mark Rule
rules.body: A topic carries its hue and symbol on its mark only: a small dot or glyph before the name. Never a coloured chip, card, column or surface, never a hue on a name, and no topic hue in a chart.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: A stroke of yellow text marker through the lower half of a word is an allowed decoration in slight, intentional use. It is static, carries no meaning of its own and appears once per view at most. Today's only use: the Jetzt headline.

rules.name: The Frozen Primary Rule
rules.body: The primary palette (forest green, hue 152) changes only by a recorded decision, never as a side effect of a feature.

rules.name: The Receding Text Rule
rules.body: Waiting cards, done titles and placeholders step down through a token colour, never through opacity on text, and keep body contrast.

rules.name: The One Role Rule
rules.body: The display face is for headings only. Numerals, labels, tab names, prompts and sentences stay in the sans, at 400 to 500 (600 for a key figure).

rules.name: The Sheets Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A shadow belongs to a sheet: a surface lifted off the canvas that holds content. A control never casts one; a selected tab or place is a fill. The one named exception is the app bar's nav pill.

dos: **Do** follow the styling priority: (1) Nuxt UI semantic tokens (`text-muted`, `bg-elevated`, `text-primary`) → (2) baseline overrides in `assets/css/main.css` → (3) custom domain tokens in `assets/css/main.css`.
**Do** put component overrides in `app.config.ts → ui.<component>` and verify slot names via the Nuxt UI MCP `get-component-metadata` or `.nuxt/ui/<component>.ts`.
**Do** use `bg-page` for the canvas and a white sheet (`PageSheet`, the card, the task sheet, a dialog, a menu) for everything read, entered or edited.
**Do** name each sheet with a heading in the display face (`SectionHeader`, `PageHeader`).
**Do** take a line height from the size token of the role (`text-body` for reading text) and a duration from the three duration tokens.
**Do** ask small questions in place, on the card or the row they belong to, and offer undo for reversible actions.
donts: **Don't** use raw Tailwind palette classes (`text-gray-600`, `bg-red-500`) or arbitrary hex/px values; ESLint warns on them.
**Don't** put more than one solid green button in a view, or use status colours for emphasis.
**Don't** put a shadow on a control, a sheet on a sheet, or a card in a card.
**Don't** add confirmation dialogs for reversible actions, or a dialog for a question that belongs to one card.
**Don't** stack modals or add toolbars to the board.
**Don't** animate for decoration, loop, or run board transitions during a drag.
**Don't** set numerals, labels or sentences in the display face, write a `leading-*` class, or use an icon size outside 12, 16, 20 and 24 px.
